title: Prakas on Application for the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard

Ministry of Commerce
No. 134 P.N.A.KBB.PRK
Prakas
On
The Application for the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard
Minister of Commerce
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0918/925 dated 06 September 2018 on the
Appointment of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0320/421 dated 30 March 2020 on the Appointment
and Adjustment to the Composition of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0618/012 dated 28 June 2018 on the promulgating the
Law on the Organization and Functioning of the Council of Ministers;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/16 dated 24 January 1996 on the promulgating
the Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Commerce;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0600/001 dated 21 June 2000 on the promulgating the
Law on the Management of Quality and Safety of Products and Services;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/1119/016 dated 02 November 2019 on the
promulgating the Law on Consumer Protection;
- Having Seen the Sub-Decree No.05 ANKR.BK dated 03 February 1998 on the Establishment of
an Inter-Ministerial Committee Coordinating the Inspection of Quality and Safety of Products and
Services;
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No.28 ANKR.BK dated 09 March 2001 on the Revision and
Supplementation of Sub-Decree No.5 ANKR.BK dated 03 February 1998 on the Establishment of
1

an Inter-Ministerial Committee Coordinating the Inspection of Quality and Safety of Products and
Services;
- Having Seen the Sub-Decree No. 38 ANKR.BK dated 16 March 2020 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Ministry of Commerce;
- Having Seen the Sub-Decree No. 160 ANKR.BK dated 29 July 2016 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Cambodia Steering Committee;
- Having Seen the Sub-Decree No. 14 ANKR.BK dated 02 February 2021 on the Amendment of
Articles 2, Article 3, Article 6, Article 7, Article 10, Article 11, Article 13, Article 16, Article 19,
Article 24, and Article 26 of the Sub-Decree 160 ANKR.BK dated 29 July 2016 on the
Organization and Functioning of the Cambodia Steering Committee;
- Having Seen the Decision No. 39 SSR dated 26 March 2021 on the Establishment of the Cambodia
Halal Steering Committee;
- Having Seen the Prakas No. 132 P.N.A.KBB.PRK dated 09 July 2021 on the Establishment of the
Secretariat of the Cambodia Halal Steering Committee;
- Having Seen the Prakas No. 133 P.N.A.KBB.PRK dated on 09 July 2021 on the Establishment of
the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group;
- Referring to the necessity of the Ministry of Commerce;
Hereby Decides
Article 1−
This Prakas is implemented to complete the Application for the usage of the Cambodian Halal
Logo and/or Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard in order to promote technical
standards, hygiene, safety and trust of Muslims and consumers towards Cambodian Halal Products
supplying in Cambodia’s market and promoting exports to international market.
Article 2−
Natural person or legal person that intends to provide services, production and packaging of
products marked or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” or “للاح ” shall apply for the Application for the
ហាទ្បាល
usage of the Cambodian Halal Logo and/or Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard at
the Consumer Protection Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate-General “CCF” of the Ministry
of Commerce as the Secretariat of the Cambodia Halal Steering Committee (CHSC) by completing the
application form and enclosing with the following documents:
2

Application for the usage of the Cambodian Halal Logo
-
Copy of Certificate of Incorporation
-
Copy of business license by sector
-
Copy of previous years Patent Tax / Value Added Tax (VAT) for self-declared taxable
-
business
A copy of the identity of the applicant (Identity Card or Passport or Equivalent)
-
Three 4x6 photos (business owner or applicant), white background
-
Chart book or other relevant information on raw materials (ingredients)
-
Other relevant documents confirming the standards of hygiene, safety, quality of the
-
requested products, if necessary.
Article 3−
After receiving the application, the Secretariat of the CHSC shall send all applications and relevant
documents to the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group within 3 (three) working days. The
Secretariat of CHSC shall coordinate (date and time) of the inspection works and assess the requirements
of compliance with halal technical standards, technical regulations and all legal documents in force for
the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group (CHTWG) within 90 (ninety) days after receiving the
application and relevant documents from the Secretariat of the CHSC.
The Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group (CHTWG) shall report on the inspection and
assessment of the requirements and attach the relevant documents (inspection records and checklists) to
the Secretariat of the CHSC.
In case the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group (CHTWG) assesses that it meets all
requirements in compliance with the halal technical standards and should be allowed to provide Halal logo
and /or the Certificate of Cambodia halal Product Technical Standard to the applicant, The Cambodia
Halal Steering Committee will grant the right to use the logo and /or the certificate of Cambodia Halal
Product Technical Standard within 5 (five) working days.
In case the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group (CHTWG) assesses that the applicant does
not meet requirements and not comply with the Halal Technical Standards, the Secretariat of the CHSC
shall communicate and facilitate the provision of this information to the applicant to adjust on the
shortcomings.
Article 4−
The validity of the Cambodian Halal Logo and/or Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical
Standard lasts for 12 (twelve) months. Applicants shall apply for the renewal of the Cambodian Halal
3

Logo and/or Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard within 30 (thirty) days prior to the
expiration date.
Article 5−
The written notification shall be provided to the Secretariat of the CHSC 30 (thirty) days prior to
the suspension or cessation of activities or relocation of halal business.
Article 6−
Prakas No. 109 P.N KNP.BRK dated 05 April 2017 on the Application for the Certificate of
Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard and any provisions contrary to this Prakas shall be abrogated.
Article 7−
Director of the Cabinet, Director General of Directorate-General, Inspector General of General
Department of Inspection, the Secretariat and the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group of the
Cambodia Halal Steering Committee, Director of the Department of Halal Affairs, Head of all relevant
units and Director of the Capital-Provincial Department of Commerce shall be responsible for the
implementation of this Prakas in accordance with their respective duties from the date of signature.
Phnom Penh, 9th July 2021
Minister of Commerce
And Chairman of the Cambodia Halal Steering Committee
Seal and Signature
PAN Sorasak
